parameter.label: P_EMPRESA : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT EMP.CODEMP AS VALUE, EMP.CODEMP || ' - ' || EMP.RAZAOSOCIAL AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP EMP ORDER BY EMP.CODEMP

parameter.label: P_UF : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT CODUF AS VALUE, UF || ' - ' || DESCRICAO AS LABEL FROM TSIUFS ORDER BY UF

parameter.label: P_TOP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT TOP.CODTIPOPER AS VALUE, TOP.CODTIPOPER || ' - ' || TOP.DESCROPER AS LABEL FROM TGFTOP TOP WHERE TOP.ATIVO = 'S' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD WHERE CAB.CODTIPOPER = TOP.CODTIPOPER AND PRO.USOPROD = 'S' AND CAB.DTNEG >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6) ) GROUP BY TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER ORDER BY TOP.CODTIPOPER

grid.expression: WITH BASE AS ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, PAR.NOMEPARC, PRO.DESCRPROD, CAB.CODTIPOPER, CAB.ISSRETIDO AS ISS_RETIDO_CAB, ITE.SEQUENCIA, ITE.CODTRIBISS, ITE.VLRTOT AS VALOR_BRUTO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'S' AND NVL(CAB.VLRISS, 0) = 0 AND (:P_DATA_INI IS NULL OR CAB.DTNEG >= :P_DATA_INI) AND (:P_DATA_FIM IS NULL OR CAB.DTNEG <= :P_DATA_FIM) AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_EMPRESA AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN :P_TOP AND CID.UF IN :P_UF ), ISS_AGR AS ( SELECT D.NUNOTA, D.SEQUENCIA, SUM(NVL(D.VALOR, 0)) AS VLR_ISS FROM TGFDIN D INNER JOIN BASE B ON B.NUNOTA = D.NUNOTA AND B.SEQUENCIA = D.SEQUENCIA WHERE D.CODIMP = 4 GROUP BY D.NUNOTA, D.SEQUENCIA ), IMPOSTOS_AGR AS ( SELECT M.NUNOTA, M.SEQUENCIA, SUM(CASE WHEN M.CODIMP = 2 THEN NVL(M.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_PIS, SUM(CASE WHEN M.CODIMP = 3 THEN NVL(M.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_COFINS, SUM(CASE WHEN M.CODIMP = 4 THEN NVL(M.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_CSLL, SUM(CASE WHEN M.CODIMP = 7 THEN NVL(M.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_IR, SUM(CASE WHEN M.CODIMP = 6 THEN NVL(M.VALOR, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_INSS FROM TGFIMN M INNER JOIN BASE B ON B.NUNOTA = M.NUNOTA AND B.SEQUENCIA = M.SEQUENCIA WHERE M.CODIMP IN (2, 3, 4, 6, 7) GROUP BY M.NUNOTA, M.SEQUENCIA ) SELECT B.NUNOTA, B.DTNEG, B.NOMEPARC, B.DESCRPROD, B.CODTIPOPER, B.VALOR_BRUTO, B.ISS_RETIDO_CAB, NVL(ISS.VLR_ISS, 0) AS VLR_ISS, NVL(IMP.VLR_PIS, 0) AS VLR_PIS, NVL(IMP.VLR_COFINS, 0) AS VLR_COFINS, NVL(IMP.VLR_CSLL, 0) AS VLR_CSLL, NVL(IMP.VLR_IR, 0) AS VLR_IR, NVL(IMP.VLR_INSS, 0) AS VLR_INSS, B.VALOR_BRUTO - ( NVL(IMP.VLR_PIS, 0) + NVL(IMP.VLR_COFINS, 0) + NVL(IMP.VLR_CSLL, 0) + NVL(IMP.VLR_IR, 0) + NVL(IMP.VLR_INSS, 0) + CASE WHEN B.CODTRIBISS = 1 THEN NVL(ISS.VLR_ISS, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS VALOR_LIQUIDO FROM BASE B LEFT JOIN ISS_AGR ISS ON ISS.NUNOTA = B.NUNOTA AND ISS.SEQUENCIA = B.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN IMPOSTOS_AGR IMP ON IMP.NUNOTA = B.NUNOTA AND IMP.SEQUENCIA = B.SEQUENCIA ORDER BY B.DTNEG DESC, B.NUNOTA DESC

chart.expression: SELECT TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'MM/YYYY') AS MES, COUNT(DISTINCT CAB.NUNOTA) AS TOTAL FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND NVL(CAB.VLRISS, 0) = 0 AND (:P_DATA_INI IS NULL OR CAB.DTNEG >= :P_DATA_INI) AND (:P_DATA_FIM IS NULL OR CAB.DTNEG <= :P_DATA_FIM) AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_EMPRESA AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN :P_TOP AND CID.UF IN :P_UF AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND PRO.USOPROD = 'S' ) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'MM/YYYY'), TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'YYYYMM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(CAB.DTNEG, 'YYYYMM')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PAR.NOMEPARC AS CLIENTE, SUM(ITE.VLRTOT) AS TOTAL FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND PRO.USOPROD = 'S' AND NVL(CAB.VLRISS, 0) = 0 AND (:P_DATA_INI IS NULL OR CAB.DTNEG >= :P_DATA_INI) AND (:P_DATA_FIM IS NULL OR CAB.DTNEG <= :P_DATA_FIM) AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_EMPRESA AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN :P_TOP AND CID.UF IN :P_UF GROUP BY PAR.NOMEPARC ORDER BY TOTAL DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
